vocabulary.meaning_en: how hot, cold, sunny or rainy it is
time when you are not working or studying
vocabulary.example: I read in my free time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you enjoy doing in your free time
making pictures with a pencil or pen

vocabulary.example: I relax at home on Friday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: good at making new things or ideas

vocabulary.note_en: Use verb-ing after it: enjoy reading.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having a natural skill to do something well
a long story in a book
vocabulary.example: I am reading a new novel.
I like fiction more than history books.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a story about a crime or secret that is solved at the end
vocabulary.example: This mystery novel is very exciting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: liked more than all the others
give something and get something back
an idea about something good to try

fine_lines.title: painting vs drawing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: painting رسم بالألوان والفرشاة، و drawing رسم بالقلم الرصاص أو الحبر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Painting uses paint and a brush. Drawing uses a pencil or pen.

examples.sentence: I made a drawing of my house with a pencil.

fine_lines.title: swap vs exchange
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان بمعنى التبادل. swap غير رسمية وشائعة في الكلام، و exchange أكثر رسمية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean give and get something back. "Swap" is informal; "exchange" is more formal.

expressions.meaning_en: An easy way to start a friendly chat.
expressions.example: Nice weather today, isn't it? Yes, it's lovely.

expressions.meaning_en: Use "by the way" to add new information, like your name.

expressions.phrase: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
expressions.meaning_ar: سعدت بلقائك. / وأنا أيضًا سعدت بلقائك.
expressions.meaning_en: Say this when you meet someone for the first time.
expressions.example: Nice to meet you, Amy. Nice to meet you too.

expressions.phrase: What do you like to do in your free time?
expressions.meaning_ar: ماذا تحب أن تفعل في وقت فراغك؟
expressions.example: What do you like to do in your free time? I like reading.

expressions.phrase: It's a great way to relax.
expressions.meaning_en: Say why you like a hobby.
expressions.example: Walking is a great way to relax.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask the other person the same question.
expressions.example: I like drawing. How about you?
Your painting is great. You're really talented.
You like novels too! We should swap book recommendations.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you are happy to meet someone.
expressions.example: I'm glad we met. See you soon.

expressions.meaning_en: Suggest staying in touch. (Shall we...? = a suggestion)
expressions.example: Shall we exchange phone numbers? Sure!

grammar.title: Talking about likes: like / love / enjoy + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: لنتحدث عن الهوايات نستخدم like أو love أو enjoy ثم الفعل مع ing: I enjoy painting. I love reading. ويمكن بعد like و love استخدام to + الفعل: I like to read.
grammar.explanation_en: To talk about hobbies: like / love / enjoy + verb-ing. After like and love you can also use to + verb.
examples: What do you like to do in your free time?

grammar.title: Question tags: "isn't it?"
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف سؤالًا قصيرًا في آخر الجملة لنطلب الموافقة: Nice weather today, isn't it? إذا كانت الجملة مثبتة بـ is يكون السؤال isn't it?
grammar.explanation_en: Add a short question at the end to ask someone to agree: It's nice, isn't it?
examples: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
This book is good, isn't it?

questions.question: What is a hobby?
choices: a job you do for money
something you enjoy doing in your free time
questions.explanation_ar: hobby هي الهواية: شيء تستمتع به في وقت فراغك.
questions.explanation_en: A hobby is something you enjoy in your free time.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ and drawing.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد enjoy نستخدم الفعل مع ing.

questions.question: Nice weather today, ___?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة فيها is (It's nice weather)، فالسؤال الذيلي isn't it.
questions.explanation_en: The sentence has "is", so the tag is "isn't it".

questions.question: Someone says "Nice to meet you!" What do you answer?
questions.explanation_ar: الرد المعتاد: Nice to meet you too.
questions.explanation_en: We answer: Nice to meet you too.

questions.question: "You're really talented" means you are...
questions.explanation_ar: talented تعني موهوب، أي ماهر جدًا في شيء.
questions.explanation_en: Talented means very good at something.

questions.question: Which word means a long story in a book?
questions.explanation_en: A novel is a long story in a book.

questions.question: "We should swap book recommendations" means...
choices: We should tell each other about good books.
questions.explanation_ar: swap يعني نتبادل، أي يخبر كلٌّ منا الآخر بكتب جيدة.
questions.explanation_en: Swap means each person tells the other about good books.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: What does you like to do?
What do you like to do?
questions.explanation_ar: الصحيح: What do you like to do?
questions.explanation_en: Correct: What do you like to do?

questions.question: I like drawing. How ___ you?
questions.explanation_ar: How about you? تعني: وماذا عنك؟
